name: ndi-legal
description: NDI's Legal Contract Assistant plugin for Claude Code and the Claude app, installable straight from this repo.

plugins.name: do-08-contract-review
plugins.description: Review and draft contracts, flag risky or non-standard clauses against the house playbook, answer policy and compliance questions, and suggest fallback language and redlines. Every position it takes is a proposal awaiting sign-off by qualified counsel. It signs nothing and files nothing.
